div.div: خَزْيَانُ Moved, or affected, with shame; (S, Msb, K, and Ham p. 36;) as also ↓ مُسْتَخْزٍ : (Har p. 482:) or, with much shame, (Lth, JK, TA,) on account of a bad, or foul, deed that he has done: (Lth, TA:) or it may signify [like خَزٍ] base, abased, abject, vile, despicable, or ignominious: (Ham ubi suprà:) fem. خَزْيَا (Lth, JK, S, K) and خَزْيَانَةٌ, which is irreg.: (TA:) pl. خَزَايَا. (Lth, JK, S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
